[type]
Lexer

[grammar]
lexer grammar M;

import sexp;

[input]
() ; a comment
[output]
[@0,0:0='(',<5>,1:0]
[@1,1:1=')',<6>,1:1]
[@2,2:2=' ',<2>,channel=2,1:2]
[@3,3:14='; a comment\n',<1>,channel=2,1:3]
[@4,15:14='<EOF>',<-1>,2:0]
[output type=lexer-only-named-types]
[@0,0:0='(',<LPAREN>,channel=0,1:0]
[@1,1:1=')',<RPAREN>,channel=0,1:1]
[@2,2:2=' ',<WS>,channel=2,1:2]
[@3,3:14='; a comment\n',<COMMENT>,channel=2,1:3]
[@4,15:14='<EOF>',<EOF>,channel=0,2:0]
